record.question: Which of the following drug is a neuromuscular blocking agent that can be used during general anaesthesia?
record.explanation: Answer A: Succinylcholine. Succinylcholine is a depolarizing neuromuscular blocker used to facilitate tracheal intubation and surgery under general anesthesia. Source/context note: Use is limited by important contraindications and adverse effects; administration requires anesthesia expertise. Reference: https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=succinylcholine. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
